APPROVE
The control flow is preserved: the `continue` chain becomes `if`/`else if`/`else`, the shard, pass-with-no-tests and uncommitted checks are extracted with the same order and the same site text, and buckets are filled in the same insertion order. `Js` itself drops to a handful of branches, well under 15, and every construct used (a nested sealed class with a primary constructor, the generic `JsBucket` helper, collection expressions) compiles cleanly, assuming the `JsInventory.Inventory`, `JsInventory.Package` and `JsInventory.Selection` type names match the existing declarations; I couldn't build it to confirm this.
